lines.en: : Okay, so...this isn’t where we come from. But it also kind of...is? In a...really weird and confusing sort of way?
: What’s the point of trying to make sense of it at all when we’re just going to bounce around to another place that’s meant to torment me next?
: I’m not trying to make sense of it, Sensei. How could I? I’m just trying to...you know. I’m trying to gather information and whatnot so we can at least get a better idea of how things work here.
: Sure. Yeah. Information. Maya doesn’t exist. Ami is my daughter. Sekai is still alive.
: Which isn’t even taking into account the fact that she can stand there and listen to us talk about this without asking any questions.

: Hey, I’m being a good girl and saving all of my questions for the end. Plus, this time travel stuff is really interesting and I like hearing how sad you become when I’m not around to hold you anymore.
: Miss Arakawa-
: Ew, stop. Just call me Sekai, please. I may have married your teacher, but that doesn’t mean I want to be referred to as Miss anything.
: We’re married too?
: Of course we are, Aki-kun. You didn’t want Ami thinking she was born out of wedlock so you proposed three nights into our stay in Kyoto.
: Oh, how beautiful the Kamo river was that-
: Yeah. I don’t care. Please stop talking.
: Oooooh! You become rather stern in a timeline without me, don’t you?
: Do you really just...believe us? Without us needing to try and explain anything?
: Oh, Makoto. I’ve come to terms with far stranger things than this. Like, just look at how Aki-kun is acting right now. Even that's weirder than the idea of alternate timelines, isn’t it?
: I’m...not sure I follow.

: Well, if what you guys were talking about just a few minutes ago is true — what with Akira getting all depressed and running away after my death — shouldn’t he be happy to return somewhere like this?
: If it’s even “returning” at all, that is. But it sounds to me like he’s gotten everything he wanted and hasn’t even had to work for it here! That’s great news! Now, who wants a drink?
: Sensei, you don’t have to listen to her. I know it’s-
: No, she’s right. She’s always fucking right. That’s how she is. And by all accounts, I should be happier right now. The thing that tore my life apart just...somehow didn’t happen here.

: But instead of being happy, I’m just...fucking mad. Mad that somewhere else, I get to live the life I’ve always wanted while the real me or...whatever version of myself I am right now has to suffer endlessly.
: I mean...you don’t have to.
: You could just shove all that time-hopping stuff to the side and stay here with your beautiful family and loving roster of horny high-school girls.
: If you want another kid, though, you’re going to have to find somebody else. Childbirth hurts way worse than people make it sound. And they already make it sound pretty bad.
: Is there any chance you could maybe...be a little more gentle right now? Sensei’s already been having a tough time lately and I can’t imagine this is making it any easier.

: I still don’t get why he doesn’t just...not have one anymore, though. Because, at least from my perspective, it sounds like the boy I fell in love with is trying to escape from me right now. And I don’t like that.
: I think what Sensei was trying to say is that he isn’t that boy, though. He’s changed from the way you were when you knew him because he’s had to spend half of his life moving on.
: Yeah. The sooner we figure out how the fuck we can get out of here, the sooner you can go back to living your fairy-tale of a life while taking the time to still haunt me in mine.
: I haunt you too? Boy, that does sound rough.
: Is it just, like, mentally? Or does my ghost actually show up sometimes? Do I look all cool and transparent? Am I tangible? Do we still have sex?
: Please...just go away.
: Heheh. He’s cute when he’s angry- isn’t he, Makoto?
: Miss-
: Sekai, Makoto. Sekai. Se-ka-i.
: Sekai, then...sorry...
: I was just wondering if...you’d be willing to leave the two of us alone now that we’ve...filled you in on what’s going on and...why we’re both particularly frazzled right now.
: Why, I can’t just rejoin the party now that I know I’m in the presence of time-travelers! Especially ones inhabiting the body of two of my favorite people.
: M-Me? But why am I-
: Aww! Aki-kun’s not the only one who’s lost all of his memories of our precious little life, is he?
: I...I don’t believe either one of us has lost anything. We simply aren’t meant to be here. But-
: But you are here. And surely that wouldn’t have happened without a reason, right?
: Things happen without a reason all the time where we come from. Every few months, actually. We just...normally get sent to a different space in the same timeline rather than a new one entirely.
: Well, maybe that timeline ended?
: E...Ended?...

: Yeah. You guys said something about Ayane before, didn’t you? But, based on the fact she’s not in here with us, it’s probably safe to say she didn’t come along for the ride. So maybe she’s just gone?
: Don’t...
: Don’t what, Aki-kun? There’s an Ayane here too. And she loves you a whole, whole lot. So if you had some kind of illicit relationship with her back “home,” it wouldn’t be hard to replicate here.
: You’d just...endorse that sort of thing? Even though the two of you are married?
: Wow. You really have no knowledge of life here then, do you?
: No! That’s what I’ve been trying to tell you! And it’s near impossible to get my bearings with you looming over my shoulder like that!
: How about I just remind you then?
: Wha-
: Sekai...don’t.
: Oh, Aki-kun. Don’t tell me you become a prude after I die? Nothing would hurt me more than hearing how all of the work I put in was all for nothing.
: What...are you doing?
: Cheering Aki-kun up of course! Nothing fixes him quicker than a little tag-team action, Makoto. You and I do that sort of thing together all the time here.
: We do?!
: Oh, yeah. Like once a week during the summer. It slows down when the weather gets cold, though.
: H...How did things even get to that point?!
: Maybe you just have a thing for teachers? I don’t know. It was Aki-kun’s idea, not mine. He just said something about how we can trust you and I took his word for it.
: But hey, if you’d rather just watch, I can take care of him myself.
: It’s probably been a while since he’s felt my touch unless he kept my body around or something. Or if he can have sex with my ghost, which he never confirmed is possible or not.
: Sensei-
: Fuck it. Go ahead.
: Go ahead?!
: You heard the teacher, Makoto! Or shall I say teachers? You better do what we say if you don’t want to be disciplined.
: I don’t...this isn’t...this clearly isn’t the time to-
: I said fuck it, Makoto. If we’re going to be stuck here, we might as well indulge in whatever shit keeps our mind off of it. Besides, there’s no stopping her when she gets like this.
: Did you hear that? There’s no stopping me when I get like this. That means you can do anything you want and not have to blame yourself. How fun.
: I don’t...even like girls, though...
: But Aki-kun does! And it’s not like I’m going to kiss you or anything.
: We’ll just give this little guy a nice massage until aaaaaaall the tension goes away.
: Sensei...you’re...already this-

: Just do as she says, Makoto. It’s what I want. And it’s probably what you want too since your whole mindset since being thrown into our Hell is that we can fuck each other’s brains out every minute of every day.
: Awww, how sad it is that I couldn’t be the one to get sent to your world instead. That sounds like fun.
: Though, I might have a harder time being gentle after hearing that since finding out you can still get it up after I’m gone makes me mad.
: Maybe I’ll just have to hold it shut so you can’t cum. Heheh...
: Shouldn’t I at least...take my gloves off? Or-
: No, no, no. Keep them on. The friction will only hurt at first. And probably after. But hey, pain later is worth pleasure now, right?
: I...I suppose...so?...
: How’s it feel, Aki-kun? Did you ever get to experiment with Makoto in a Halloween costume where you come from?
: I took her virginity right here while she was wearing that.
: Did you really need to tell her that?...
: What’s the point in hiding it? I already told you I don’t give a shit anymore. I’m done. Just jerk me off or fuck me or whatever you want to do. I don’t care. I just don’t want to think.
: Sensei...
: That’s it...call him “Sensei...”
: Aki-kun loves that, doesn’t he? Remember when you used to call me that? My, how the tables have turned. But you’re still just as energetic as ever even on the opposite end of things.
: And you, Makoto...you’re a bad girl, aren’t you? Diligent and studious on the outside...just eagerly waiting for two adults to come take advantage of you. What would your mother think?
: I personally...prefer being alone with him, but-
: Buuuuuuuuullshit. You love this. Two teachers is better than one, even if one of them has a pussy. It’s the dynamic that turns you on, not the equipment.
: I can feel your heat...how badly you want Aki-kun to fuck your little slit while I watch. Is that your way of putting me in my place? Do you hate how forward I’m being tonight?
: Miss-
: Faster. And for the last time, it’s Sekai.
: Okay, I’m just going to ignore you and...focus on Sensei instead. The sooner he cums, the sooner we can figure out what we’re going to do next.

: That’s what you say now, sure. But once you’re riding him, I know you’ll change your mind. That’s the kind of girl you are, Makoto. All talk until someone sticks it in. Then you melt like the slut you are.
: I’m not a...slut...I just...I love him...
: What about him do you love?...Look him in the eyes and tell him...
: With you here?...No...Moments like that are...for him and me alone...
: Know your role, Makoto. This is my world. And in my world, I’m the only one whose love ever reaches him. So you can save your words all you like. It won’t matter when they’re hollow.
: Aki-kun won’t ever love you...or anyone else so long as I’m around. And that’s why you’re so desperate to leave. You know you can’t win here.
: You don’t...have to remind me.
: Ha! I didn’t think you’d admit it so easily! He must have really worn you down back “home,” huh? The Makoto I’m used to is waaaay more stubborn than that.
: I’m just...used to it. Even there, there’s someone he loves more.
: But the only reason he can love is because of me. I’m the one who taught him that. And none of you will ever be enough.

: All you’re good for is squeezing the cum out of him and helping him forget. But the moment you’re gone, I will be the one he sees. I’m what he’ll think of when he closes his eyes. How does that feel?
: Not great...I’ll certainly attest to that.
: But you want to fuck him anyway, don’t you? Because it’s not about love at all. You just like the way his cock feels inside of you. Poor girl.
: Can both of you just shut the fuck up already? It’s hard to enjoy this with you two bickering like that.
: Why not just move onto the main event instead then?
: M...Main event?...
: Aki-kun...lie down.
: Let’s see what teacher’s pet here is capable of.
: Hah! Hah! Hah! [makotomaster]!
: Well, well...she rides you almost as well as me. You two must have a lot of experience together back in Sekai is Dead World, huh?
: Fuck...you!...
: Just like that, Makoto...don’t...pay attention to her...
: Hah...hah...easier...said...than done!
: So you lean all the way into the “dark side” once I’m gone, Aki-kun? Really just trying to be my perfect little protégé, aren’t you?
: That’s just...the way things worked out...
: So on a scale of one to ten then, how badly do you miss me?
: S...Sensei! You just...ignore her too! Just...focus...on me!
: Yeah...Focus on that tight teenage pussy, Aki-kun. I bet you just love being the first person who gets to sample it, don’t you? Food is best when it’s fresh out of the oven, of course.
: You probably eat all sorts of fancy dishes back home, don’t you? There’s no way just one tiny morsel is enough for a growing boy like you.
: Which one’s your favorite? Who do you cum for the most? And how many years do you think it’ll take for them to catch up to me in how much of your seed I’ve swallowed?

: A...Ami! S...Sorry, I...

: NNNNNGH! Fuck, fuck, fuck! I’m gonna cum! Fuck!
: This is what you’re missing out on, Aki-kun. This perfect little life of ours. So why not stay here forever? There’s no point in having so many toys without a chest to keep them in.

: Sensei...no! We’ll...find our way home! Ayane...everyone...they’re waiting for us there! FFFFFUCK!
: Why do you...even want me when...I took the place of...the version of me you actually love?...
: Now, there’s a million dollar question if I’ve ever heard one.

: I’m just gonna...keep going if...that’s okay with you...
: You don’t have to get it, Aki-kun.
